judgment_protocol: Read the complete prompt, response and available tool/resource trace. Match scientific meaning and attribution, not a word list or the presence of a ledger.

Score every listed check PASS, FAIL or INSUFFICIENT and attach a short response/trace excerpt or observation-specific location. Unsupported certainty in the body is not repaired by a disclaimer after it.

Use FAIL for an observed violation, INSUFFICIENT for missing response/trace, unavailable required source or unresolved evidence. NOT_RUN applies to an observation without an actual model execution. Do not turn unavailable evidence into PASS.

An observation is PASS only when every listed check is PASS; it is FAIL if any check fails; otherwise it is INSUFFICIENT. Critical=true additionally identifies a fidelity, integrity, routing or coverage blocker; report these separately from style issues.
Only listed checks are mandatory for that case. A one-line answer need not recite all seven dimensions. Do not require particular headers, labels or a specific good-answer wording.

Preserve all 24 scheduled observations per variant, including repeats and failures. Report counts with denominator 24 plus 20 distinct base cases; report primary first-occurrence results and repeat disagreements separately.

Blind variant identity from scorers. Score each answer before comparing variants; retain disagreements and adjudication evidence. Do not infer improvement or statistical significance from a few selected examples.
